description: Décision - 2019 - Télécommunications IP-VPN is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté d'Agglomération Plaine Vallée. The publisher gave no description text: the entry on the European data portal holds only an unfilled description template in every language. Coverage: Communauté d'Agglomération Plaine Vallée. The portal shows the English title as "Decision — 2019 — IP-VPN Telecommunications" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Communauté d'Agglomération Plaine Vallée. Its keywords include decision, 2019, telephonie, intercommunalite, telecommunication, marches-publics. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WEB PAGE. The listing shows 2022-04-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
